column1: # Kothon: English words commonly spoken inside Bengali, as the Bengali
# models spell them, and how to write them in English.
# Format: bengali<TAB>english. Several spellings may map to one word.
# Left out on purpose: words that are also ordinary Bengali words
# (বস sit, বাস dwell, বিল wetland, মল, গোল round, কল tap/machine,
# ওকে him/her, কপি cabbage, বাই "by", বাগ garden).
